title: Kichwa language - Wikipedia
text: Kichwa is a Quechuan language that includes all Quechua varieties of Ecuador and Colombia, as well as extensions into Peru. It has an estimated half million speakers.

title: Quechua, Southern Pastaza | Ethnologue Free
text: Inka Autonyms. Southern Pastaza Quechua. Summary. Southern Pastaza Quechua is a stable indigenous language of Peru. It belongs to the Quechuan language family and is part of the Quechua macrolanguage. The language is used as a first language by all in the ethnic community.
